data.body: Description condensed for the plan-review close gate. During implementation two long sections ('Companion-ticket status, corrected' and 'Code-reading corrections') were appended to the DESCRIPTION, taking it from 4392 to 8980 chars. That made the close gate report stale-material, and a re-review was not possible either: 8980 chars is over the 8000-char plan-review admission cap (criterion P4), so review-plan would have blocked it unread. The description is now 6412 chars and retains all the substance - Context, Approach (including why the decision table is NOT moved and why apply_inbound_events stays separate), Guard construction, Scope, Testing, a compressed 5-point corrections summary, and all 9 acceptance criteria with their existing ticks. Nothing was dropped that changes the plan; the FULL code-reading corrections, the Gerrit 2044 companion-ticket detail, and the landed AC evidence remain verbatim in the two earlier comments on this ticket, which are immutable. Re-running review-plan now against the condensed text.
